headline: BIDA, BEZA and PPPA merge to form 'Invest Bangladesh'
summary: The new Invest Bangladesh Authority has officially begun operations, with BIDA, BEZA and PPPA dissolved. The agency consolidates Bangladesh's investment development functions.
why: Investment promotion agencies coordinate foreign direct investment and special economic zones, influencing how easily companies can set up and operate in a country.
